best.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a fun-sized window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 121 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 72/100, and wind is the main risk.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 6-9s at mid tide can turn Belgas punchy and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; exposed north spot needs Lagide to be under 1 m; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
best.shortExplanation: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

ranked.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 130 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 72/100, and wind is the main risk.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: wind is over 30 km/h; wind fit is poor or too strong; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy; SwellMap rating 2/10 Poor — caution.
